See also: media, Media, medía, and mediá

French

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /me.dja/
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Toulouse)):(file)

Etymology 1

[edit]

Shortened from English mass media.

Noun

[edit]

média m (plural médias)

  1. media
    L'association a appris à maîtriser les médias.
    The association has learned to control the media.
  2. (media) outlet
    un média de propagande russe / américain ― a Russian/American propaganda outlet
Usage notes
[edit]
  • (media in general): Typically in the plural.

Hungarian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From English (mass) media.[1]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈmeːdijɒ]
  • Hyphenation: mé‧dia
  • Rhymes: -jɒ

Noun

[edit]

média (plural médiák)

  1. media (television, newspapers, etc.)
  2. media (formats for presenting information)

Usage notes

[edit]

Some do not use the plural version.

Portuguese

[edit]
Portuguese Wikipedia has an article on:
média
Wikipedia pt

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈmɛ.d͡ʒi.ɐ/ [ˈmɛ.d͡ʒɪ.ɐ], (faster pronunciation) /ˈmɛ.d͡ʒjɐ/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈmɛ.d͡ʒi.ɐ/ [ˈmɛ.d͡ʒɪ.ɐ], (faster pronunciation) /ˈmɛ.d͡ʒjɐ/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈmɛ.d͡ʒi.a/ [ˈmɛ.d͡ʒɪ.a], (faster pronunciation) /ˈmɛ.d͡ʒja/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈmɛ.djɐ/ [ˈmɛ.ðjɐ]

Etymology 1

[edit]

Feminine of médio (“medium”), from Latin medius, from Proto-Indo-European *medʰyo- (“between”).

Noun

[edit]

média f (plural médias)

  1. (statistics) average
    1. arithmetic mean
    2. measure of central tendency
  2. (education) the score necessary to go from one grade to another
  3. (Brazil) coffee with milk
  4. (Brazil, Baixada Santista) pão francês
Derived terms
[edit]
  • acima da média
  • em média
  • média aritmética
  • média cúbica
  • média geométrica
  • média harmônica
  • média ponderada
  • média proporcional
  • média quadrática
Related terms
[edit]
  • medial
  • mediar
  • médio
  • meia
  • meio

Adjective

[edit]

média

  1. feminine singular of médio

Etymology 2

[edit]

Borrowed from English media, mass media.

Noun

[edit]

média m pl (plural only)

  1. (Portugal, journalism) media; mass media
Alternative forms
[edit]
  • media
  • mídia (Brazil)
